title: Add opt-in panes layout
description:
# Brief 2: opt-in panes layout (feeds | article list | article)

## Why
Today an opened article slides in as a drawer over the list. Users can opt into a
3-column layout instead: the article shows in a pane next to the list. The drawer
stays the default. This repo is a fork that merges upstream often: put new code
in new files and keep edits to existing files small.

## Read first
- Root `AGENTS.md` (repo rules), `.agents/AGENTS.md` (fork rules)
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-view.tsx`: `useArticleViewState()` and
  `ArticleView`, already shared by the drawer
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-drawer.tsx`, `article-page.tsx`,
  `components/layout/app-layout.tsx`, `store/preferences.ts`,
  `components/settings/settings-dialog.tsx` (the auto-mark-read row)

## Files allowed
- `frontend/src/store/preferences.ts`
- `frontend/src/components/settings/settings-dialog.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-pane.tsx` (new)
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-page.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/layout/app-layout.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-item.tsx`
- `frontend/src/lib/i18n/messages/*.ts` (all 8 locales)
- `docs/frontend-design.md`
Touch nothing else (not `settings-sync.ts`, not the backend, not `components/ui/`).
No git commands.

## What to do
1. **Preference.** In `preferences.ts` add `readingLayoutOptions = ["drawer", "panes"]`,
   type `ReadingLayout`, default `"drawer"`, `setReadingLayout`, and normalise it in
   `merge` the same way `autoMarkRead` is (an older persisted blob lacks the key).
   Add it to `partialize`. It is per device: never sent to the server.
2. **Settings row.** In `settings-dialog.tsx`, add a "Reading layout" select directly
   below the auto-mark-read row, same markup. Its `onValueChange` calls
   `setReadingLayout(v)` only: no `applySetting`, no `beginChange`, no PATCH.
3. **ArticlePane** (`article-pane.tsx`). Calls `useArticleViewState()` once. When
   `state.isOpen` is false, or the article is not loaded yet, it shows a centred
   empty state: lucide `BookOpen` icon (muted, about 48px) and the text
   `article.pane.empty`. Otherwise `<ArticleView state={state} variant="pane" />`.
   Root: `<section className="flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">`.
4. **Layout switch.** In `article-page.tsx`: `panes = readingLayout === "panes" && !isMobile`
   (`useIsMobile`). When `panes`, render inside `AppLayout` a row: the `ArticleList`
   in a `w-[400px] shrink-0 border-r` column, then `<ArticlePane />`. Otherwise render
   exactly what it renders today. Pass `readingPane={panes}` to `AppLayout`, which
   skips `<ArticleDrawer />` when `readingPane` is true. Every other page keeps the
   drawer (search can open an article from any page).
5. **Scroll into view.** In `article-item.tsx`, when the row becomes selected, call
   `scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })` on its root element (ref + effect).
   This applies in both modes.
6. **Text.** New keys in all 8 locale files, translated properly and in the style of
   each file (e.g. `de.ts` writes umlauts as plain letters):
   `settings.readingLayout.label` "Reading layout",
   `settings.readingLayout.description` "Drawer opens articles over the list. Panes shows them in a column beside it (wider screens only).",
   `settings.readingLayout.drawer` "Drawer", `settings.readingLayout.panes` "Panes",
   `article.pane.empty` "Select an article to read".
7. **Docs.** `docs/frontend-design.md`: in section 3 the `article` row says "Opened
   article (drawer or reading pane)"; in section 4 Desktop, say the article opens in
   the drawer or, with the panes layout, in a column beside a 400px list; in
   section 5, note that the reading layout is the one preference kept per device
   and never synced. Change only those sentences.

## Hard constraints
- At any moment exactly one of `ArticleDrawer` or `ArticlePane` is mounted. Both
  call `useArticleViewState()`, which registers keyboard navigation; two mounted
  means `j` skips articles.
- Do not change `article-view.tsx`, `article-drawer.tsx` or any hook.
- Drawer mode must look and behave exactly as before.
- No new dependencies. No tests of wording.

## Checks (run in `frontend/`, all must pass)
- `pnpm run typecheck`
- `pnpm test`
- `pnpm run check:i18n`
- `pnpm build`

## Report back
- The checks' last lines.
- Anything you had to do differently from this brief, and why.
acceptance_criteria: In frontend/: pnpm run typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm run check:i18n, pnpm build pass; exactly one of ArticleDrawer/ArticlePane mounted; click-through in both modes.

title: Split ArticleDrawer into state hook + view
description:
# Brief 1: split ArticleDrawer into state hook + view (no visible change)

## Why
A later change adds an inline reading pane next to the article list. It must show
the same article UI as the slide-out drawer. This step only separates logic from
presentation so both can share it. Nothing may change for the user.

## Repo
/Users/m/git/refusion, frontend in `frontend/`. Read `AGENTS.md` (root) first.

## Files allowed
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-drawer.tsx` (edit)
- `frontend/src/components/article/article-view.tsx` (new)
Touch nothing else. No git commands.

## What to do
1. In `article-view.tsx`, export a hook `useArticleViewState()` that contains,
   moved unchanged, everything `ArticleDrawer` computes today before its `return`:
   URL state, `useArticleList`, mutations, read-state pins, the article/readArticle
   resolution, `useAutoMarkRead`, all handlers, and `useArticleNavigation`.
   Keep every existing comment, word for word, next to the code it explains.
   It returns what the JSX needs (article, readArticle, canToggleRead, feed,
   bookmark, starred, safeArticleLink, the handlers, goToNext/goToPrevious/
   hasNext/hasPrevious, and a `close()` that calls `setSelectedArticle(null)`).
2. In the same file, export `ArticleView({ state, variant })` with
   `variant: "drawer" | "pane"`. It renders the header, content and footer
   exactly as the drawer's JSX does today, and returns `null` when there is
   no article. `SheetTitle` (sr-only) renders only for `variant === "drawer"`.
   `getLinkDomain` becomes a module-level function in this file.
3. `ArticleDrawer` becomes a thin shell: it calls `useArticleViewState()` at its
   top level (outside the Sheet), then renders the same `<Sheet>`/`<SheetContent>`
   as today with `<ArticleView state={state} variant="drawer" />` inside.

## Hard constraints (these are the bugs to avoid)
- The hook must run in `ArticleDrawer` itself, never inside `SheetContent`.
  Today the logic runs while the drawer is closed; `useAutoMarkRead` relies on
  seeing its target go to `null` when the article closes. Moving the hook inside
  the Sheet would unmount it on close instead and change that behaviour.
- `useArticleNavigation` must still be called exactly once by the drawer path,
  with the same `enabled: selectedArticleId !== null` and the same callbacks.
  A second call registers a second keydown handler and `j` skips articles.
- No renames of i18n keys, CSS classes or props; no new dependencies;
  no behaviour or styling changes; no "while I'm here" cleanups.
- Comments only where the repo's rules say so (`AGENTS.md`, Code Standards).

## Checks (run in `frontend/`, all must pass)
- `pnpm run typecheck`
- `pnpm test`
- `pnpm run check:i18n`

## Report back
- The checks' last lines.
- Any place you could not move code unchanged, and why.
acceptance_criteria: In frontend/: pnpm run typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm run check:i18n pass; diff -w of old drawer vs article-view.tsx shows only the hook/view seams; drawer click-through unchanged.

title: 3-pane reading layout (opt-in)
description: Opt-in panes layout as an alternative to the article drawer. Spec and decisions in design.
design:
Spec: opt-in 3-pane reading layout (feeds | article list | article) next to the existing slide-out drawer.
Plan: (1) split ArticleDrawer into useArticleViewState() + ArticleView, no visible change; (2) readingLayout preference, settings picker, ArticlePane with empty state, list row scroll-into-view, docs (frontend-design.md sections 3 and 4).
Same URL state (?article=) in both modes; exactly one of drawer/pane mounts the state hook.
Upstream declined a 3-pane view (0x2E/fusion#158), so this stays in the fork, kept in new files where possible.

Decisions 2026-10-09:
- readingLayout is per device (localStorage), never synced to the server.
- Picker only in the settings dialog (MVP).
- Panes at every desktop width; mobile always uses the drawer.
- Default stays "drawer"; list column 400px; empty pane = lucide BookOpen + "Select an article to read".
